overview: Cosmix Engineering lists a desiccant adsorption dehumidifier as its own range, separate from AUX and from CLIVET. This type of unit is used where a room has to be kept drier than a cooling coil alone would manage, including storage and process rooms. The previous website described this item with cassette wording, which was not about a dehumidifier, so that wording is not used here. The manufacturer is not confirmed on this page. Ask Cosmix for the series it can supply and for a quotation.

features.title: Its own catalogue
features.text: Dehumidifiers are not shown with AUX products or with CLIVET products. A quotation for this range is prepared on its own.

features.title: Adsorption drying
features.text: Air passes over a drying material. The unit is considered when the room needs a low humidity, including when cooling is not the main requirement.

features.title: Quoted per project
features.text: Air volume and the humidity to be held are confirmed before a model is offered. No size table is published until the series is confirmed.

ctaText: Share the room, the humidity you need to hold, and the city. Cosmix will reply with the series it can supply.

overview: Cosmix Engineering lists an inverter dehumidifier as a second, separate range. An inverter model uses a refrigerant circuit and a variable-speed compressor to remove moisture in rooms and smaller commercial spaces. The previous website used slim-duct wording for this item. That description was not about a dehumidifier and is not repeated here. The manufacturer and the capacities are confirmed when you ask for a quotation.

features.title: Its own catalogue
features.text: This page does not borrow AUX or CLIVET products. Related equipment stays inside the dehumidifier range.

features.title: Inverter operation
features.text: Variable-speed compressor control is the reason this model is listed apart from the desiccant unit. Running figures are not published until the series is confirmed.

features.title: Quoted per project
features.text: Room size and the moisture load decide the model. Cosmix confirms the manufacturer before offering a price.
